promptText: Which upper-upscale hotel brands should an owner consider for an upper-upscale hotel positioning strategy in Europe?
rawText:
For an **upper-upscale hotel positioning strategy in Europe**, an owner should primarily evaluate brands that are already recognized in the **upper-upscale chain scale** and have meaningful European presence, especially **Radisson Blu**, **Autograph Collection**, **Sheraton**, **InterContinental**, **Le Méridien**, **Hilton**, **Hyatt**, **Sofitel**, **Pullman**, and **Meliá**-type regional upscale brands.[2][8][18]

The strongest candidates from the supplied sources are:

- **Radisson Blu** — identified as Europe’s largest upper-upscale hotel brand in the MKG Hospitality ranking.[1][4]
- **Autograph Collection** — listed by STR as an upper-upscale chain brand.[2]
- **Sheraton** — described in the luxury hierarchy source as part of the upper-upscale segment.[8]
- **InterContinental** — also placed in the upper-upscale segment and widely used across Europe.[8][10]
- **Hyatt** and **Hyatt Regency** — included among upper-upscale/upscale brands in the provided brand guidance.[8][10]
- **Hilton** and **Hilton Hotels & Resorts** — included in the upper-upscale category and among major Europe luxury/upscale players.[8][9]
- **Le Méridien** — listed in the upper-upscale segment.[8][10]
- **Sofitel** and **Pullman** — positioned in the upper-upscale tier.[8]
- **Meliá** / **NH Collection** — highlighted as Europe-relevant upscale brands with properties tailored to leisure and business travelers.[18]
- **Kempinski** — presented as a high-end upper-upscale brand with strong European relevance.[8][18]

If you want the **most Europe-centric shortlist**, the best starting set is **Radisson Blu, Sofitel, Pullman, Meliá, NH Collection, Kempinski, and InterContinental** because they combine upper-upscale positioning with stronger regional recognition in Europe.[1][8][18]

If you want, I can turn this into a **brand-selection matrix** for Europe by **asset type** (city hotel, resort, heritage conversion, airport, mixed-use) or by **owner goal** (fees, loyalty, ADR, renovation flexibility).
